wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=The Explorers HQ |characters=エクスプローラーズ本部 |japanese=Explorers HQ |caption=Explorers HQ |image=Explorers HQ.png |imagesize=250px |region=Unknown |colorscheme=ZA |epicode=HZ124 |episode=HZ124 }} The '''Explorers HQ''' (Japanese: '''エクスプローラーズ本部''' ''Explorers HQ'') is the center of the [[Explorers]]'s operations. == History == In [[HZ124]], [[Spinel]], the leader of the Explorers, as well as the director of [[Exceed]], sent five of the [[Six Heroes]] to be placed under captive inside the facility to ensure the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] wouldn't manage to rescue them. Despite [[Liko]], [[Roy]], [[Dot]], and [[Ult]] launching an operation alongside [[Amethio]], [[Onia]], and [[Zirc]] to rescue them, they were all trapped by the Explorers once they managed to get inside, separating them from each other and placing them into contact with the Explorers admins, who had one of the Six Heroes each by their side to assist them under the influence of the [[Super Strong Sphere]]. In the [[HZ125|following episode]], Liko, Roy, Dot, Ult, Amethio, Onia, and Zirc were successful in defeating the Explorers-controlled Six Heroes, and later [[Pagogo]] was able to free them from the effects of the Super Strong Spheres. In the aftermath, however, Spinel used altered footage of the battle to create further distrust against the Rising Volt Tacklers, framing them as criminals who took the Six Heroes from the care of the Explorers when they were found injured on [[Mount Pericarp]]. == Pokémon seen at the Explorers HQ == {| width="70%" | {{InactivePoké|Lucius|Arboliva|Lucius Arboliva.png|grass|normal}} | {{InactivePoké|Lucius|Moltres|Lucius Moltres.png|dark|flying}} | {{InactivePoké|Lucius|Lapras|Lucius Lapras.png|water|ice}} ♀ |- | {{InactivePoké|Lucius|Kleavor|Lucius Kleavor.png|bug|rock}} | {{InactivePoké|Lucius|Gouging Fire|Lucius Gouging Fire.png|fire|dragon}} |} == Gallery == File:Explorers HQ interior.png|The Explorers HQ's interior File:Explorers HQ blueprints.png|The Explorers HQ's blueprints ==Related articles== {{Miscanime}} {{DoubleProjectTag|Anime|Locations|locations in the animated series.}}
